problem: What is the cardinality of $A\times B$ for $A={0,1,2,3,...,7}$ and $B={a,b,c,d}?$
worked_solution:
For any two finite sets $A$ and $B,$ the cardinality of $A\times B$ is

$$
|A\times B|=|A|\cdot |B|.
$$

In this case, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}|A\times B| & =|A|\cdot |B| \\  & =8\cdot 4 \\  & =32.\end{aligned}
$$
